A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same E2LLM research work, with 36 readable pages including Appendices A–J. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the text, equations, tables and figures.

before.justification: v2 reports original E2LLM evaluations on summarization, question answering and LongBench v2 in Section 3, alongside RULER experiments and ablation results in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark performance, retrieval augmentation, efficiency measurements and appendix ablations.

M1.justification: The chunker, encoder, vPMA adapter, decoder, reconstruction and reasoning objectives, and optional retrieval augmentation retain the same procedures and components.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same summarization and QA datasets, LongBench v2, RULER, and LCC/RepoBench code-completion evaluations. The appendix test scenarios and task coverage are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the document-task comparisons (Tables 1 and 7), LongBench v2 accuracy and timing comparisons (Tables 2–3), and RULER evaluation (Table 12).

E3.justification: The reported splits, sample counts, metrics, model configurations, training budgets, retrieval settings and efficiency-testing procedures remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the same component ablations, retrieval analyses, context-length and hyperparameter sensitivity studies, model-scaling experiments, and TriviaQA and extremely long-input case studies.

E5.justification: Appendices E.3, F.2 and H.2 retain single-run evaluation with do_sample=False. Neither version adds repeated-run information, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests.

E6.justification: Corresponding benchmark, efficiency, ablation and case-study results are unchanged, including the appendix results. For example, Table 2 reports E2LLM-7B overall LongBench v2 accuracy of 31.8% in both versions.

T1.justification: The vPMA equations (1)–(3), context-window reasoning, and complexity expressions in Section 2.3, Table 5 and Appendix D are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about balancing performance, efficiency and pretrained-model compatibility, outperforming eight baselines, and leading comparably sized models on LongBench v2.

C2.justification: The interpretations of semantic compression, retrieval, efficiency and generalization remain unchanged. Both versions retain the same qualifications about fine-grained recall, training-data acquisition and chunk-size selection.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, training and inference instructions, and code/model/data access links remain unchanged. No additional reproducibility information is supplied.

R1.justification: The reference list and substantive research positioning in the introduction and Appendices A–C are unchanged. Existing citations receive formatting edits without adding or removing cited works.

P1.justification: v3 adds Section 5, Acknowledgements, identifying Ant Research Fund support and NSFC grant 62572198. Several existing citations change to parenthetical formatting; the research narrative and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: All five figures and sixteen tables are retained. Changes comprise minor spacing and caption citation formatting, reflow around the new acknowledgements and references, and a shifted text break across pages 30–31.

improvement.justification: v3 adds funding disclosure and adjusts citation presentation. These modest editorial additions leave the scientific explanation, empirical support, limitations and reproducibility information unchanged across the main text and appendices, producing no meaningful overall quality difference.
